negatives.failure_signature: A combined status and two-slice source read exceeded the twenty-second command budget after returning only the initial source slice.

negatives.recurrence_guard: Read large predecessor builders in independently bounded slices and require the whole requested slice to exit successfully before using it as evidence.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the incomplete read earned zero x2 evidence credit
